shellCommands.command: git ls-files && git diff && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50 && cat package.json && ls node_modules/next/package.json && node -p "require('next/package.json').version"
cd /workspace; for f in pages/*.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /workspace; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/next/
cd /workspace; cat node_modules/next/AGENTS.md | head -60; grep -ril "migrating from pages\|app-router-migration" node_modules/next/dist/docs | head
cd /workspace; f=node_modules/next/dist/docs/02-pages/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md; wc -l $f; sed -n '/## Upgrading/,/### Step 5/p' $f | head -300

cd /workspace; cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/02-pages/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md; grep -rl "app-router-migration" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | head -3; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace; git rm -rq pages && ls; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30

cd /workspace; (npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &); sleep 4; for p in / /about; do echo "=== $p"; curl -s localhost:3123$p | grep -oE ']*>|[^<]*|]*>|]*>|

[^<]*

|[^<]*'; done; pkill -f "next start"; git status --short
cd /workspace; pgrep -f "next start" || echo stopped; git status --short; git diff tsconfig.json
ps aux | grep -i next | grep -v grep || echo none
